answer_1.quote: We instruct two representative LLMs: ChatGPT and InstructGPT-3, to generate natural language explanations for each of its results on mental health analysis.

answer_2.quote: We select the following widely utilized metrics to automatically evaluate LLM-generated explanations: BLEU, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, GPT3-Score (davinci-003), and BART-Score.

answer_3.quote: We also use BART-Score and GPT3-Score to automatically evaluate explanations, which rely on LLMs to score fluency, reliability, and completeness.

answer_4.quote: We examine the quality of the generated explanations by two representative LLMs ... with human evaluations ... Each aspect is divided into four standards rating from 0 to 3.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rate explanations on four aspects: Fluency, Reliability, Completeness, Overall, using a 0–3 scale.
